data.body: Gerrit 1877 advisory remediation: replaced the exact prose-sentence assertion with an order/punctuation-tolerant semantic-clause check that independently requires the canonical directional, non-blocking, and non-cycle-inducing properties. Final-form oracle proof: removing caused_by only from the relation inventory produced RED with missing=[caused_by]; restoring inventory but removing only the non-blocking semantic property produced RED with caused_by semantics omit non-blocking; restoring both returned GREEN. Combined caused_by and relation-scoped-unlink documentation contracts pass 4/4; make lint, make typecheck, and diff-check pass. This preserves the refactoring litmus while retaining teeth for both inventory and semantics.
